name: Erina
source: After Erina is capture by Baron Squid he tries to force her to give up her humanity and become a monster girl. If Leo is too slow in rescuing her she becomes a monster girl, is forced to marry Baron Squid, and becomes pregnant with his child. In the end Leo tames her as his own monster girl.
